process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running: `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied`. The calls were `gh pr view 222 --json ...`, `git diff --stat fde86d1e21ebf8afd2560349e289eb656941d31e..HEAD` and `git rev-parse HEAD`. The sandbox (bubblewrap/seccomp) cannot start on this runner, so the PR diff, metadata, threads and head SHA could not be read.

No reviewers were spawned. They share the same broken Bash sandbox and could not fetch the change (`gh pr diff` / `git diff`), so any review would have been ungrounded. PR #222 was NOT reviewed and needs a re-run once the runner sandbox is fixed.
